prompt: a clean architectural perspective RENDER of an indoor WOODEN STAIRCASE receding away from the viewer. There are 5 steps. Paint a single crisp bright-RED line along the front NOSING EDGE of every step (the horizontal front lip of each tread), 5 red lines in all. PERSPECTIVE IS THE SUBJECT and must be EXACT (do NOT default to drawing the nosing edges as evenly stacked horizontal lines): because all the nosing edges are parallel in the real world and recede from the camera, when you EXTEND each red nosing line it must meet all the others at ONE single shared vanishing point. Every red edge, extended, passes through that one common point. Photoreal materials, correct converging perspective, no text, no numbers, no grid, no drawn vanishing lines beyond the 5 red nosing edges themselves.
